tasks.title: Extend the schema for lifecycle delivery
tasks.description: Add the four lifecycle values to emailEvents.template, add registrationId, idempotencyKey and attempts to emailEvents, and add the optional emailOptOut flag to registrations. Keep existing rows valid.

tasks.title: Build the template registry and escaping renderer
tasks.description: Create convex/lifecycleTemplates.ts with the four templates (subject, HTML, text), a renderer that escapes every interpolated value, and a key builder returning registrationId + template.

tasks.title: Build the idempotent dispatch action
tasks.description: Create convex/lifecycleDispatch.ts: write the emailEvents row for the key before sending, skip when a row already exists, honour the preference for optional templates, and send through the existing Mailtrap transport to exactly one recipient.

tasks.title: Bound and record retries
tasks.description: Record the provider reason on failure, increment attempts, stop at the configured limit, and expose the failure in the admin delivery view. Never throw into the registration path.

tasks.title: Schedule the confirmation at registration
tasks.description: After a successful registration, schedule the confirmation dispatch and return without awaiting the provider.

tasks.title: Add the reminder sweep
tasks.description: Add a cron that selects confirmed registrations for events starting within 24 plus or minus 1 hours and dispatches the reminder for those without a delivery row.

tasks.title: Add the follow-up sweep
tasks.description: Add a cron that selects registrations for events that have ended and dispatches the thank-you once, skipping opted-out attendees.

tasks.title: Add the attendee email preference
tasks.description: Expose a mutation that sets emailOptOut and a control in my-tickets, stating that the registration confirmation is not affected.

tasks.title: Show lifecycle delivery in admin
tasks.description: Surface per-registration delivery rows (template, status, timestamp, error) in the existing admin email log.

tasks.title: Prove the one-recipient and escaping rules
tasks.description: Add a check that a rendered template contains only its own registration context and that interpolated values are escaped.

tasks.title: Prove idempotency and bounded retries
tasks.description: Prove that a repeated sweep sends nothing, that a cancelled registration gets no reminder, and that a failing send stops at the attempt limit and stays visible.
